message: A credential carried in a URL's userinfo is now masked wherever secrets are redacted, including the YAML `GET /admin/config` and `GET /admin/config/effective` return. `key_management.crypto.root_of_trust.address` is an unparsed URL under a key name no pattern matched, so `https://sbproxy:hvs.MUSTNOTAPPEAR...@vault.internal:8200` came back in full while the `token` beside it was masked. The scheme and the host survive the mask, so the route still says which key service is configured.
